data.name: Sharvi
data.gender_notes: Sharvi is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sharvi is a Hindu girl name which means 'Goddess of Fortune'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Shri', which is a name of Lakshmi, the Hindu goddess of wealth and prosperity. The name Sharvi carries the meaning “Goddess of Fortune” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Sharvi usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of fortune and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes abundance, prosperity, and good fortune.
data.etymology: Sharvi belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Fortune.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharvi total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
